title: rust-lstm: recurrent neural networks with verified backpropagation through time in Rust
description: A dependency-light Rust library for LSTM, GRU, bidirectional and peephole LSTM networks with training by backpropagation through time, dropout and zoneout regularisation, optimisers, learning-rate schedulers and model persistence. Every backward pass is checked against finite differences, and outputs and gradients are compared with PyTorch in continuous integration.
